mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM boarding_records WHERE status = 'BOARDING'
SELECT type AS petType, COUNT(*) AS typeCount FROM pets GROUP BY type

SELECT p.id AS petId, p.name AS petName, p.type AS petType, o.name AS ownerName, COUNT(b.id) AS totalBoardingTimes FROM boarding_records b INNER JOIN pets p ON b.pet_id = p.id INNER JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.type, o.name ORDER BY totalBoardingTimes DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MONTH(check_in_date) AS periodNum, COALESCE(SUM(total_fee), 0) AS totalRev FROM boarding_records WHERE YEAR(check_in_date) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(check_in_date)
SELECT QUARTER(check_in_date) AS periodNum, COALESCE(SUM(total_fee), 0) AS totalRev FROM boarding_records WHERE YEAR(check_in_date) = #{year} GROUP BY QUARTER(check_in_date)
